scope: Actual in-app browser interaction with isolated authored 12-motor simulation and the existing disconnected preview
checks: Enter selects the twelve-motor profile; focus returns to that profile and aria-pressed becomes true
Requests expose aria-busy=true, then false when complete
Navigation focuses the new page heading
All 72 missing facts are represented in a collapsed complete list and associated with fields
Fill simulation example retains action focus and immediately clears outdated validation marks
Keyboard ArrowDown converts first motor travel from 5mm to 0.196850393701in; focus remains on its unit control
Keyboard ArrowUp returns the value with the already documented bounded display rounding
Zero pulse timing fails strict format validation without saving it
A 1ns timing choice produces a saved semantic blocker and aria-invalid/described field feedback
Clicking its error link opens the closed Advanced section and focuses the correct timing field
Correcting timing to 5000ns permits review and a simulation-only saved generation
Adding an output retains Add output focus; removing the assignment falls back to the stable page heading
All five views passed at 390x844, 800x480, 1280x800 and 1920x1080 with verified actual viewport dimensions
No horizontal page overflow; measured visible control heights are at least 44 CSS pixels
Fault example uses dark panels and separate labelled alarm, warning and coverage presentation
Temporary test tab closed, viewport override reset, existing setup preview retained
limitation: This pass verifies frontend rendering and interaction. The prior in-app browser saved-download limitation and physical machine acceptance gates remain open.
